source_name: NLB Group — Kosovo subsidiary page and group investor/press releases
why_relevant: NLB d.d. is Ljubljana-listed and majority owner (~82%) of NLB Banka Prishtina; group IR announcements and the market page are an authoritative, regularly updated channel for subsidiary CEO/board appointments and structural changes, often in sl/en and mirrored in sr.

source_name: TEB Sh.A. Kosovo — corporate site news / announcements
why_relevant: TEB (TEB/BNP Paribas joint venture) posts dated corporate announcements on its own site — recent items observed include sponsorship renewals and branch relocations (Aug 2026), i.e. an actively maintained channel where organizational and network changes surface first.

source_name: BKT Kosova — Shpallje / Announcements
why_relevant: BKT Kosova's own announcement stream (branch notices, guarantee-fund agreements, pricing changes) — the channel where reorganizations and branch/division changes appear; a companion sq path exists.

source_name: BKT Kosova — Bordi i Drejtorëve (Board of Directors)
why_relevant: Governance roster for the Kosovo entity under a /management/ tree; diffing it detects board changes at the largest Albanian-owned bank operating in Kosovo.

source_name: Banka Kombëtare Tregtare (group, Tirana) — Lajme & Lajmërime
why_relevant: Group-level Albanian newsroom of BKT covering a 94-branch network across Albania and Kosovo; group appointments (including who runs BKT Kosova) and the group Bordi Drejtues page are published here rather than on the Kosovo site.

source_name: Banka Ekonomike — Board of Directors / corporate pages
why_relevant: Domestically-owned bank publishing its board roster and, importantly, shareholder-assembly convocations (ftesa për mbledhje të aksionarëve) that precede board elections; it also announced acquiring the assets/liabilities of the Türkiye İş Bankası Kosovo branch — a live organizational-change signal.

source_name: BPB — Banka për Biznes: Lajmet (news)
why_relevant: Dated news stream of a locally-owned commercial bank (operating since 2001); carries product, partnership and corporate items and is the natural place for management or structural announcements. sq equivalent path /sq/lajme/.

source_name: Ziraat Bank Kosova — Karriera (careers) and Për ne (about)
why_relevant: Smallest of the covered banks and the least press-active; its careers page (CV intake at career_hr@ziraatbank-kosova.com) and 'Për ne' page are the only own-channel signals of hiring and organizational profile. A site sitemap page exists, easing crawl discovery.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (Kosovo Banking Association) — Komunikatat / Lajme
why_relevant: Sector association whose communiqués name the CEOs of member banks (e.g. its assembly elected the NLB CEO as board chair and the BKT CEO as vice-chair). Its committee announcements (payments, cybersecurity) also reveal which bank units and executives exist. Best single pointer for cross-bank leadership mapping.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association news tag on Telegrafi
why_relevant: A pre-built sq-language tag feed aggregating banking-association and member-bank items; useful as a low-cost tripwire that surfaces bank corporate announcements republished as press releases, including leadership news.

source_name: Gazeta Kosova — BKT Kosova tag feed
why_relevant: Per-bank tag archive that aggregates BKT Kosova press releases and coverage; the same tag pattern can be reused for other banks on this and similar sq outlets, giving cheap per-actor monitoring feeds.

source_name: KosovaJob — employer profile pages for Kosovo banks
why_relevant: Banks maintain branded employer profiles here and post vacancies; profile pages are a per-employer hiring feed for banks (Banka Ekonomike, Ziraat, and the banking association itself all have profiles), covering the jobs/hiring topic where bank sites lack a vacancy listing.

source_name: OfertaPune.net — Kosovo vacancy portal
why_relevant: Second major sq-language vacancy portal in Kosovo; banks advertise here too, so it provides redundancy against a single job board and catches postings that never reach a bank's own careers page.

source_name: Bank LinkedIn company pages (ProCredit Kosova, TEB Sh.A., BPB, Ziraat Bank Kosova)
why_relevant: Every covered bank runs a LinkedIn page; appointment posts, 'welcome to the team' posts and vacancy listings appear there first and often exclusively, and the People tab reveals division names (i.e. organizational structure) that no press release states.

source_name: Bank official Facebook pages (NLB Kosovo, TEB, BPB, Kosovo Banking Association)
why_relevant: In Kosovo, Facebook is a first-class corporate channel: several banks post announcements there that never appear on their websites, and page posts are in sq (some sr), covering leadership introductions and branch/organization news.

source_name: Central Bank of Kosovo (BQK) — Lajme dhe ngjarje / licensed-institution register
why_relevant: The regulator approves bank board members and material structural changes (e.g. it approved Banka Ekonomike's takeover of the Türkiye İş Bankası Kosovo branch). Its news feed and licensing register are the authoritative pointer that a private-bank organizational change is real and dated, and it enumerates the full actor list for this cell.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of banks in Kosovo / Banking in Kosovo
why_relevant: Low-credibility but useful actor-map seed: enumerates licensed banks, ownership and official/alias names in en and sq, which drives glossary building and ensures no bank in the cell is missed as ownership changes.

source_name: EMIS company profiles — key executives for Kosovo banks
why_relevant: Commercial database maintaining 'contacts & key executives' records per Kosovo bank entity; useful as a cross-check on executive rosters when a bank's own page is stale, and it carries the legal entity names (Sh.a.) used in official filings.

source_name: Ekonomia Online — Biznes & Financa section
why_relevant: Kosovo's most economy-focused Albanian-language portal; its Biznes & Financa desk routinely publishes appointment stories using the exact local formula 'X emërohet Kryeshef Ekzekutiv i ...' (verified pattern on the site's own KEK CEO appointment piece). Best single high-volume feed for bank leadership and org-change items.

source_name: Ekonomia Online — site RSS feed
why_relevant: A machine-readable full-site feed advertised by the portal itself; the cheapest continuous ingestion path for A5 headline signals from the leading Kosovo economy outlet.

source_name: Telegrafi — tag archive 'shkarkim' (dismissals)
why_relevant: A topic-native archive for the single most important A5 verb in Albanian ('shkarkim' = dismissal/removal). Cross-referencing this tag against the bank actor map isolates leadership removals without keyword sweeping the whole site.

source_name: Telegrafi — tag archive 'bordi i drejtorëve' (board of directors)
why_relevant: Board-composition changes at banks and at the Central Bank of Kosovo are the governance layer of A5; this tag concentrates them under the exact Albanian institutional term.

source_name: KALLXO.com — tag 'Bankat në Kosovë'
why_relevant: BIRN Kosovo / Internews Kosova investigative platform; it is the outlet most likely to surface non-public governance facts about bank management (conflicts of interest, alleged oligopoly conduct, complaint volumes) that never appear in a press release. Highest-credibility Albanian-language investigative source in the cell.

source_name: Buletini Ekonomik — Ekonomi section
why_relevant: Specialist Kosovo economic bulletin covering banks, fees, profitability and — verified on-site — executive appointments ('X emërohet drejtor ekzekutiv i ...') and suspensions of officials. Narrower than the general portals so signal density for A5 is high.

source_name: Koha.net (Koha Ditore online)
why_relevant: Kosovo's reference daily of record; its Ekonomi desk is the outlet most likely to treat a bank restructuring or merger as a substantive business story rather than a one-line notice. Essential archival depth for retrospective A5 reconstruction.

source_name: Zëri (zeri.info) — Aktuale/Ekonomi desk
why_relevant: Long-running Albanian-language daily brand named in the cell definition; carries appointment, resignation and institutional-governance stories and provides an independent second confirmation channel against Telegrafi/Koha.

source_name: Klan Kosova (klankosova.tv)
why_relevant: Major national broadcaster with a web desk; verified to publish appointment-process stories in the exact 'Drejtor Ekzekutiv' framing. Broadcast reach means executive-change interviews and on-record management statements often originate here.
